recipes.name: Perfect Chimichurri Sauce
ingredients: ¾ cup (90ml) extra virgin olive oil
Kosher salt and pepper to taste
instructions: In a medium mixing bowl, combine parsley, garlic, shallot, fresno chile, vinegar, and olive oil.
Stir well to combine and season with salt and pepper to taste.
Transfer to a storage container and allow to sit for at least 1 hour.
